notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Misc
- Removed some additional wording in the server browser
- VSync enabled on launch
- Added launch options. - DX11 configuration for machines that were unable to launch the game regularly
- Leaderboard expanded to Top 50, up from Top 10

Balance

Hemlock
-Small nerf to Hemlock's ability to sustain ammo

Faraday
-50% faster reload time for Faraday - We want to improve how clunky Faraday feels to play, This should help tip the scales.
-Reduced lightning spread on basic attack. This will lead to more damage and properly reward good aim.

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
- Fixed Achievements that were activating when they weren't supposed to
- Fixed online lobby music playing twice for the host
- Fixed online lobby lighting
- Fixed a typo in the tutorial
- Fixed a small area of the map that was untextured

notes.title: Known Bugs
notes.content:
Hello world! Thank you for trying out HeXpunk!

We've received some great feedback, and also picked up some pesky bugs along the way.

We plan to address these bugs within the near future:

Achievements
- Novice Magician & Master Magician Unlocked Every Game Win.
- Secret Achievement Unlocked Every Game Win.

Multiplayer
- Quick Match sometimes loads into a broken match. Use the server browser in the meantime.
- On the Game Over Screen, when a Joined Player selects Main Menu they are held at the loading screen until the Host    Player selects a menu option. 
- Multiplayer Lobby Friends List shows some away friends as offline/disabled.
- Multiplayer Lobby Steam Profile Pictures are not loaded for Joined Player.
- Multiplayer Lobby lighting on Low Graphics settings to be adjusted.
- Shaders Recompile when a Joined Player is sent back to the Main Menu.

Tutorial
- Crash on Tutorial Loading on some machines.
- Missing letter in Weapon Instructions prompt.

UI
- Multiplayer Respawn Prompt still visible in Game Over screen.
- Opening Steam Overlay during Game Over screen can randomly hide your mouse cursor indefinitely. Game must be restarted to fix.
- Match does not Pause when a Controller is Disconnected or the Steam Overlay is opened.
- Low Health Red Edge Glow shows while respawning in Multiplayer.
- Timer freezes only on the host when pausing in a multiplayer game.
- Timer freezes on pause, but does not unfreeze on resume.

Audio
- Low Health Heartbeat SFX plays during Game Over screens.
- Low Health Heartbeat SFX plays while respawning in Multiplayer.
- Low Health Heartbeat SFX for the Joined Player are heard by the Host Player.
- Multiplayer Lobby Music for the Host Player is doubled when a Joined Player connects.

Performance
- Game crash on cards with 4GB of VRAM or less, on launch.
- Game launches into a black screen on Steam Deck
